NETRA TEST POLICY DOCUMENT
Scheme: NETRA Rural Skill Support Yojana (NRSSY)
Document ID: NRSSY-TEST-88421

Eligibility:
- Resident of rural area aged 18 to 45 years
- Family annual income below Rs 2,50,000
- Must have Aadhaar and bank account

Benefits:
- Skill training stipend of Rs 5,000 per month for 6 months
- Tool kit grant of Rs 12,000 after course completion
- Placement assistance through district skill centre

How to apply:
1. Visit nearest Common Service Center with Aadhaar
2. Submit Form NRSSY-01
3. Helpline: 1800-555-8842

Unique token for retrieval tests: zebra-mango-7741
